title: Real-Ribasim external-owner equivalence with product-conformant linear fixed-weir mapping

predecessor.reason_for_new_candidate: The V1 three-point table was not equivalent to the intended linear Q(h) because Ribasim uses PCHIP interpolation.

purpose: Retest the same external surface-water ownership claim with a Ribasim representation that exactly encodes the intended linear above-crest fixed-weir Q(h) while preserving Ribasim's native zero-flow rule below the lowest table level.

authorities.product_interpolation_authority: Pinned Ribasim TabulatedRatingCurve documentation: PCHIP interpolation and Q=0 below lowest supplied level.

scientific_change_from_v1.physical_law_unchanged: Q=0 for h<=0; Q=0.5*h m3/day for 0<h<=1
scientific_change_from_v1.justification: With exactly two table points PCHIP is the straight segment between them; below 0 m Ribasim's documented below-lowest rule gives Q=0.

frozen_mapping.storage_mapping: V_m3 = level_m + 1.0 for 1 m2 constant Basin area; SWAP oracle storage_cm converts as V_m3 = storage_cm * 0.01

comparators: integrated weir discharge inferred from the independent Ribasim mass ledger

preregistered_method_difference.explanation: F-CI52 uses an implicit end-step rating balance; Ribasim integrates the continuous linear ODE. This numerical-method difference is expected and remains well inside the frozen 1e-8 m endpoint tolerance.

hypotheses: C0 remains below crest with zero discharge and matches the canonical oracle.
C1 and C2 discharge with the intended linear Q(h).
All three final levels and storages match the canonical F-CI52 oracle within the unchanged frozen tolerances.
Integrated Ribasim discharge inferred from the mass ledger matches the oracle discharge within the unchanged frozen tolerance.
Ribasim alone owns the surface-water state in the candidate route.
failure_rule: Do not change cases, duration, physical law or scientific tolerances after execution. A mismatch outside the frozen envelope is an R2 falsification and remains visible.
pass_meaning: Bounded evidence that the restricted linear fixed-weir surface-water storage/level/discharge responsibility can be externally owned by real Ribasim for the tested no-supply profile.
nonclaims: No production admission or retirement authority.
